text:
leo_onboard: morning all — can't access the Runtime Grafana dashboards or the Sentry project. Grafana shows 'Dashboard not found' and Sentry 403. onboarding doc link is https://internal.redwood.ai/onboarding/observability but the screenshots don't match what I see.
devex_bot: Welcome to Redwood! Check the observability quickstart: https://internal.redwood.ai/onboarding/observability. If access issues persist, ping #devex or @platform.
leo_onboard: thx bot. tried incognito, same. i can log into Okta ok.
rita_platform: hi Leo — can you paste the exact Grafana URL? also what's your okta email?
leo_onboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/runtime-overview and leo.z@redwood.ai
rita_platform: quick check shows you're not in the obs-view group. I'll add you now; should sync in ~2-3m.
noah_runtime: fyi Runtime dashboards are in folder 'teams/runtime' — if you still can't see them, maybe your role is Viewer vs. Editor. Viewer sees and pin, Editor can save.
leo_onboard: added? i still get 403 on Sentry: https://sentry.redwood.ai/organizations/redwood/projects/runtime/
devex_bot: Action: added leo.z@redwood.ai to group obs-view by rita_platform.
rita_platform: i also triggered a manual Okta->IAM sync for Leo.
leo_onboard: access-check output: groups: engineers, obs-view. Sentry still 403 though.
rita_platform: weird. Sentry uses a separate project invite in some older orgs. gimme a sec, sending direct invite to project.
claire_docs: small request: can someone update the onboarding page to mention the occasional separate Sentry invite and the access-check helper? I missed that when I onboarded.
rita_platform: invite sent. try again.
leo_onboard: can open Sentry now! thanks. Grafana now shows the dashboards too. :relieved: one last tiny ask: where's the best place to request dashboard tweaks or create a new panel?
noah_runtime: open a PR against grafana-dashboards repo and drop a link in #runtime with a short description. for urgent tweaks ping @noah_runtime.
leo_onboard: perfect. i'll file a small PR and add notes. thanks everyone for the fast help :thumbsup:
